AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Dec-18-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: Commissioner Sue M. Kaplan, Clerk: Carla Amador & Sajja Ravinantapricha, CSR: Maureen Howard #7156 (Department 218)

Appearances:
Petitioner, Alonso R. Lobato, is present in propria persona.

This matter comes on calendar this day for an Order to Show Cause hearing re Change of Name and Gender. Alonso R. Lobato is sworn and examined by the Court.

The Court, after review of the court's file, received a declaration from the doctor, but it does not state that the petitioner has complied with the California Health and Safety Code and therefore DENIED without prejudice petitioner's request for a change of gender.

The matter having been submitted and no objections having been made to the proposed change of name made at the hearing, it appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: JESSICA ALONSO LOBATO. Decree is submitted and signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME AND GENDER
Off Calendar Oct-25-2007 Denied
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name and Gender.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: K. Farnsworth.
Petitioner: Alinso R. Lobato, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name and gender were made at the hearing.
After hearing the testimony and evidence presented, matter is DENIED without prejudice.
Petitioner to file an Amended Petition with proper Name and to obtain and file a valid Medical Certificate.
